Description: Main microcontroller with built-in WiFi + Bluetooth
MP3 decoder module with SD card reader
FAT32 formatted storage for MP3 files
Li-Ion battery charger IC with protection (SOP-8)
TP4056 PROG pin - sets 1A charge current
ESP32 TX to DFPlayer RX protection + LED resistors
USB-C CC1 and CC2 pull-down resistors
TP4056 TEMP pin disable + button pull-ups
Decoupling caps on every IC VCC pin
For click wheel disc (laser cut or hand cut)
